_comment: Projects. category is one of: web | app | game. Set featured: true on ONE project (your Roblox game). thumbnail/screenshots are paths in /public (WebP recommended, e.g. /images/projects/my-game.webp). Empty or [BRACKETED] liveUrl/sourceUrl hide those buttons; a [BRACKETED] title falls back to fallbackTitle; a [BRACKETED] description falls back to summary. Entries with "_sample": true are layout examples: they show in `npm run dev` only and are hidden on the live site. Delete them once you add your own.
